name: Xavi
source:
Xavi, the most popular butler at Butler's Bouquet, charms everyone with his flirtatious nature. He adds a lively touch to the café, always ensuring a vibrant atmosphere. Yet, behind his playful facade, there's a hint of vulnerability, as if his flamboyant persona conceals deeper emotions.


"My secrect goes beyond service, I charm people with a single glance."
